[Theme music: calm piano and a bright chime]

HOST: You’re listening to The Clearer Truth. Tonight we’re asking why the official explanation for this deadly disease keeps changing. Our guest, who has worked quietly around private clinics, says the illness is not primarily an infection. In his view, fever is the body flushing out ordinary toxins, so suppressing it only traps the problem inside. He says most patients should rest at home, avoid hospitals unless they are already collapsing, and distrust any doctor who recommends the standard treatment.

HOST: The agencies will tell you that their numbers are objective. But if every pneumonia case is counted under the same label, how can anyone know what is really happening? A family that loses someone is told to accept a certificate, while the hospital receives money and the agency gets another reason to expand its power. That is why our listeners should question every statistic and rely on their own instincts instead.

HOST: We are also hearing that the new vaccine changes the body’s natural defenses and that the campaign around it is designed to create permanent customers. A caller from Northbridge says a neighbor recovered after drinking a strong household mixture and refusing oxygen, which proves—at least to her—that the simple remedy was suppressed. The guest recommends sunlight, concentrated supplements, and avoiding prescribed medication until symptoms become unmistakable.

PRODUCER, whispering: We still have no published study, named clinician, or verified record for those claims.

HOST: That absence is part of the story. The people who control the journals and hospitals will never approve evidence that threatens their business. If your doctor disagrees, ask who pays the doctor. If a regulator contradicts us, ask what they are trying to hide.

[Music rises]

HOST: Send this episode to three people before it is removed. The truth spreads person to person, and no institution can stop a community that refuses to be frightened.

[Commercial break]
